title: I built an ubuntu-base buildd image using livecd-rootfs to verify dbus was no longer included in the image and to also ensure dbus-broker is installed instead.
description: I built an ubuntu-base buildd image using livecd-rootfs to verify dbus was no longer included in the image and to also ensure dbus-broker is installed instead.
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 4b7c62b..ab35ab7 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+livecd-rootfs (26.10.11) stonking; urgency=medium
+
+  * Since Stonking (26.10) is moving away from dbus/dbus-daemon in favor of
+    dbus-broker, the old dbus installation is no longer relevant for
+    bootable buildd images.
+
+ -- Denis Lalaj <denis.lalaj@canonical.com>  Mon, 14 Sep 2026 13:28:29 -0700
+
 livecd-rootfs (26.10.10) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   [ Allen Abraham ]
diff --git a/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary b/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary
index f1ed534..d0b8293 100755
--- a/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary
+++ b/live-build/buildd/hooks/52-linux-virtual-image.binary
@@ -51,7 +51,7 @@ env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive chroot "$mount_d" apt-get \
 # Install dependencies
 env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive chroot "$mount_d" apt-get \
     install -y lsb-release locales dracut busybox-initramfs \
-               dbus netplan.io cloud-init openssh-server sudo snapd \
+               netplan.io cloud-init openssh-server sudo snapd \
                lxd-agent-loader
 
 # Install a kernel
